config_patches:
"$patch": "delete"
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"kind": "KubeFlannelCNIConfig"

---
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"kind": "KubeNetworkConfig"
"podSubnets":
- "10.100.0.0/20"
"serviceSubnets":
- "10.10.0.0/16"

---
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"clusterDNS":
- "10.10.0.254"
"kind": "KubeletConfig"

---
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"kind": "SecurityProfileConfig"
"workloadIsolation": true

---
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"hostDNS":
  "enabled": true
  "forwardKubeDNSToHost": false
"kind": "ResolverConfig"
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"kind": "SysctlConfig"
"params":
  "fs.inotify.max_user_watches": "524288"
  "user.max_user_namespaces": "11255"
  "vm.max_map_count": "1048576"
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"defaultRuntimeSeccompProfileEnabled": true
"kind": "KubeletConfig"
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"filesystem":
  "type": "xfs"
"kind": "UserVolumeConfig"
"name": "data"
"provisioning":
  "diskSelector":
    "match": "system_disk"
  "grow": true
  "minSize": "100GiB"
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"kind": "TimeSyncConfig"
"ntp":
  "servers":
  - "10.2.0.53"
  - "10.2.0.54"
"machine":
  "logging":
    "destinations":
    - "endpoint": "tcp://127.0.0.1:6050/"
      "format": "json_lines"

---
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"kind": "KmsgLogConfig"
"name": "vector"
"url": "tcp://127.0.0.1:6051/"
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"enabled": false
"kind": "KubeProxyConfig"

---
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"enabled": false
"kind": "KubeCoreDNSConfig"

---
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"certExtraSANs":
- "optiplex"
- "optiplex.lolwtf.ca"
- "optiplex.folly.lolwtf.ca"
- "folly.lolwtf.ca"
- "10.3.0.10"
"extraArgs":
  "enable-aggregator-routing": "true"
"kind": "KubeAPIServerConfig"
"accepted":
  "audiences":
  - "api"
  - "https://kubernetes.default.svc"
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"issuer":
  "issuerURL": "https://oidc.lolwtf.ca/folly"
"kind": "KubeServiceAccountConfig"
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"configuration":
  "anonymous":
    "conditions":
    - "path": "/livez"
    - "path": "/readyz"
    - "path": "/healthz"
    "enabled": true
  "jwt":
  - "claimMappings":
      "username":
        "expression": "\"federated:\" + claims.sub"
    "claimValidationRules":
    - "expression": |
        claims.sub in [
          "system:serviceaccount:atlantis:atlantis",
          "system:serviceaccount:mate:mate-sandbox-admin",
          "system:serviceaccount:mate:mate-sandbox-reader",
          "system:serviceaccount:kthx-engine:kthx-engine"
        ]
      "message": "only the Atlantis, Rowbutt sandbox (admin and reader) and kthx engine
        service accounts may authenticate across clusters"
    "issuer":
      "audiences":
      - "api"
      "url": "https://oidc.lolwtf.ca/offsite"
"kind": "KubeAuthenticationConfig"
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"kind": "VolumeConfig"
"name": "ETCD"
"provisioning":
  "diskSelector":
    "match": "system_disk"
  "maxSize": "8GiB"
  "minSize": "8GiB"
"allowedKubernetesNamespaces":
- "backups"
"allowedRoles":
- "os:etcd:backup"
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"kind": "KubeTalosAPIAccessConfig"
"cluster":
  "etcd":
    "extraArgs":
      "listen-metrics-urls": "http://0.0.0.0:2381"

---
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"extraArgs":
  "bind-address": "0.0.0.0"
"kind": "KubeControllerManagerConfig"

---
"apiVersion": "v1alpha1"
"extraArgs":
  "bind-address": "0.0.0.0"
"kind": "KubeSchedulerConfig"
